en: The front of the postcard shows a hand-tinted image of a large neo-gothic church with a tall central steeple and red-brick details, located in a town setting with surrounding greenery. There is text at the bottom that reads 'KYRKAN I SUNDSVALL.' The back features a green stamp from Sweden dated 1910 and is addressed in Swedish in ornate handwriting. The postcard uses multiple languages for 'postcard,' suggesting it was meant for international as well as national mailing.
